title: refactor: panel-server Python split
desiredOutcome: panel-server.py drops from ~4,500 post-P11 lines to ~1,700: settings schema, discovery, read-side state and the write path live in four flat _panel_*.py modules, each carrying the selftest cases that pin it; panel-server keeps the HTTP handler, lifecycle, UI assembly and the integration selftest. Total selftest case count never decreases.
summary: panel-server.py fell 8,287 (pre-P11) -> 4,521 (post-extraction) -> 1,818 lines: the settings schema (_panel_settings, 41 cases), discovery (_panel_discovery, 11), the read side (_panel_state, 48) and the write path (_panel_write, 108) each own themselves, with the server keeping the handler, lifecycle, UI assembly and 238 integration cases. Case count grew 428 -> 469 across the family; four break/confirm/restore proofs show the moved suites still bite; memo identity (cores, journal) is shared rather than copied and pinned from both sides. The desired outcome (~1,700 target) reads 1,818 - the number documents, it does not drive. One executor was cut mid-stream by an API error and resumed against verified tree state.

tasks.title: _panel_settings.py: form schema + key allow-lists
tasks.description: Move lines 75-352 (FIELD_HELP, COMPOSITION_HELP, SETTINGS_GROUPS, _settings_paths, _cfg_enums via _loader) plus the _META/_PHASE/_TASK key sets. _help.py:783 stops importlib-execing panel-server for _settings_paths and does a plain import _panel_settings — same commit, with the coverage cases proving resolution still works. Each moved selftest case moves with its code.

add: settings coverage derived from validate-config KNOWN_* sets, now in _panel_settings

outcome.technical: FIELD_HELP/COMPOSITION_HELP/SETTINGS_GROUPS, the five write allow-list key sets, _settings_paths and _cfg_enums moved to _panel_settings.py (453 lines); panel-server aliases them so the substitution chain and write path are untouched. _help's s8/s9 coverage now imports _panel_settings locally instead of loading the whole server by path. Case arithmetic: panel 428 = 391 + 37 moved; _panel_settings carries 41 (37 verbatim + 4 new isolation cases); combined 432 >= 428.
outcome.descriptive: The settings schema owns itself now, with its own coverage selftest, and help reads it from the module that owns it.

tasks.title: _panel_discovery.py: skills/agents/MCP discovery
tasks.description: Move lines 466-605 (_fm_of, _scan_skills, _scan_agents, _plugin_bases, discover, _local_plugin_bases, _mcp_names); front matter via _help.front_matter. Discovery selftest cases move along.

outcome.technical: Nine discovery names moved to _panel_discovery.py (254 lines) with the 7 fixture-dir cases plus 4 new isolation cases (cap-fallback read, own-plugin labeling, sorted MCP names, no upward imports). panel-server aliases the names; /api/registry and policy_state unchanged. 391 = 384 + 7; combined 395.
outcome.descriptive: The registry scan owns itself, pins itself, and the panel cannot tell.

tasks.title: _panel_state.py: the read side
tasks.description: Move path safety (_within/_config_path/_manifest_path/_declared_as_of), _viewer, read_config, bugs/composition/areas/journal/help/policy state, lock detection, usage_state, report_paths, render_report, build_state (lines 382-1450 minus the write functions). The largest single move; read-path selftest cases (sharded areas, policy verdicts, journal paging, usage empty-views) move along.

outcome.technical: The whole read side (path safety, viewer, every GET payload builder, lock detection, usage/report state) moved to _panel_state.py (1347 lines); panel-server 4046 -> 2965 with 41 aliases back. 384 = 341 + 43 moved verbatim; 5 new isolation cases incl. journal-memo-shared-by-identity and every-alias-actually-defined. Boundary decisions documented in the docstring: _cores memo moved (two memos are two answers), _read_json moved with alias, journal memo shared by identity, _src_of_this_file deliberately NOT aliased so source-slice cases assert their own file.
outcome.descriptive: Every GET payload the panel serves is now built by a module that answers for itself, with the server keeping only the serving.

tasks.title: _panel_write.py: locks, diffs, journal, writes
tasks.description: Move write_policy/write_areas, the write-lock trio, diff+journal helpers, write_config, _reject_unknown, apply_composition_patch, _touched_phase_ids, _write_back, apply_composition (1035-1105 + 1451-1961). Write-path selftest cases (composition sharded write-back, lock refusal, change rows, journal call site) move along.

outcome.technical: The write path moved verbatim to _panel_write.py (1377 lines): atomic writer wrapper (kept - ensure_ascii=False is the panel's byte shape and seven inlines are seven drifts), write_policy/areas/config, the lock trio, change-row helpers, _journal and the composition writers. Journal memo reached through _panel_state by identity - no third dict - pinned from both sides. panel-server 2965 -> 1818 lines with 17 aliases. Arithmetic: 341 = 238 + 103; _panel_write 108; combined 346 >= 341.
outcome.descriptive: Locks, diffs, journal and the four writers live in their own module with the 103 cases that pin them.

tasks.title: Slim panel-server.py: handler, lifecycle, assembly, integration selftest
tasks.description: Prune dead imports; keep _make_handler + _free_port (the source-slicing selftests split on def do_GET / def do_PUT / def _free_port and must keep matching), pidfile lifecycle, UI assembly + substitution, main, and the integration selftest: UI_HTML pins, route-coverage slicing, HTTP round-trips, pidfile lifecycle, one end-to-end save through _panel_write. Phase sign-off asserts total case count >= pre-phase and mutation-proves one moved case per new module.

outcome.technical: Verification pass, zero net edits: ruff found no F401, every function has a live caller, every alias line is pinned by the split modules' own isolation cases, the do_GET/do_PUT/_free_port slice markers are unique, and the route coverage enumerates every served route. Four mutation proofs (allow-list key, discovery labeling, lock verdict, change-row field) each went red by name and were restored to an empty diff. Case accounting: 238+41+11+48+108+23 = 469 >= 451 pre-phase.
outcome.descriptive: panel-server.py is already exactly its post-split scope; the four new suites were proven to still catch real regressions, and nothing needed to move.
